PROGRAM.md’s M0–M6 ladder remains the scope map, but PRODUCT.md is now the operative sequencing authority. M3 is split: P2 covers 2D portraits, environments, enemy variety, and Cala in-game; P3 then covers 3D main-cast/boss batch production and Taste Gate 2 entry. [PROGRAM.md:15-19](epoch0-main/docs/program/PROGRAM.md:15), [PRODUCT.md:231-238](epoch0-main/docs/program/PRODUCT.md:231)

P2 does not wait for Taste Gate 2. Taste Gate 2 is a consultative, non-blocking milestone at P3 entry; the Art Lead determines readiness, engineering validates integration, and owner silence neither blocks production nor endorses it. [PRODUCT.md:174-188](epoch0-main/docs/program/PRODUCT.md:174)

M4 Audio/Taste Gate 3 remains unplaced and therefore unscheduled relative to P1–P5—not implicitly deferred to P5. The frozen sources preserve its M4 scope (“full soundscape”) but provide no authoritative P-slot assignment. [PROGRAM.md:11-18](epoch0-main/docs/program/PROGRAM.md:11), [PRODUCT.md:208-214](epoch0-main/docs/program/PRODUCT.md:208)
